title: Bug: crm/test_crm.py::test_crm_route is flaky on platforms that use total_routes = 1
author: markx-arista
body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

Low

### Description of the bug

https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/pull/22132 added polling with counter tolerance 2, but when total_routes is 1 the tolerance let the wait pass before the CRM counter actually moved, which makes wait_until check for check_route_added/check_route_deleted useless and the test flaky.

### Steps to Reproduce

Run crm/test_crm.py::test_crm_route on broadcom XGS platforms

### Actual Behavior and Expected Behavior

wait_until check for check_route_added/check_route_deleted should address total_routes = 1

Fixes #25661
